keyEvents.text: Goal! Alcoyano 0, Mallorca 1. Abdón Prats (Mallorca) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal.
Adam Buksa (Mallorca) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! Alcoyano 1, Mallorca 1. Guille Andrés (Alcoyano) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Pablo Carbonell.
Javier Soler (Alcoyano) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Aboubaka Soumahoro (Mallorca) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Luis Orejuela (Mallorca) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Loren Fernandez (Alcoyano) is shown the yellow card for excessive celebration.
Goal! Alcoyano 1, Mallorca 2. Adam Buksa (Mallorca) header from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.
Cristian Filipov Bachev Tabachki (Alcoyano) Substitution at 114'
Goal! Alcoyano 1, Mallorca 3. Adrián Fuentes (Mallorca) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Pablo Torre.
